item.title: The King's Plea
item.author: thekingsscribe7@gmail.com (se7en Adeniyi)
item.description:
The KING's heart yearns for thee; come home --- tis the plea.

My child, come back home to Me.

Every step you take, away from the light I set within you, brings you that much closer to the abyss’ edge. Every breath you draw, outside union with Me, could be the one before I lose you forever.

Mine is a Father’s heart: broken for you, daily. Please come back home, my child. My heart is incomplete without you. I love you so!

My Scribe, se7en, will relay to you, the very thoughts of My Heart.
Please, take My outstretched hand: let Me save you.
I’ll respect your choice; but make it count, for both our sakes.
